title: Analytic: hollow PEC rectangular waveguide modes and cutoffs (em_modes)
description:
A hollow (vacuum) 2.0 x 0.9 um rectangular metal pipe seen in cross-section: em_modes with pec on all four faces (no PML), uniform 20 nm cells; frequency_domain study over 1.0-3.9 um (30 wavelengths, 5 modes each); mode_dispersion follows TE10 (mode 1), TE01 (mode 3) and TE11 (mode 4; TE11 and TM11 are degenerate, so it follows either or a mix of the two, with the same n_eff).
Wall plane: every wall sits on the inner face of the outermost cell (a ghost cell), so the guide is a_guide x b_guide = size - 2 dx_cell per axis.
Analytic: n_eff^2 = 1 - (m lambda / (2 a))^2 - (n lambda / (2 b))^2; cutoffs 2 a = 4.0 um (TE10), 2 b = 1.8 um (TE01), 1.64 um (TE11); beyond its cutoff a mode is evanescent (Re n_eff 0, dashed curve 0).
Spectra tab: modes.te10 / te01 / te11, quantity n_eff vs wavelength with the analytic curve dashed (overlap stays 1: the hollow-guide mode shapes do not depend on the wavelength).
Derived values tab at lambda0 = 1.5 um: expected relative n_eff error ~7e-6 (TE10), ~5e-4 (TE01), ~9e-4 (TE11): the finite-difference transverse wavenumber (2/h) sin(m pi h / (2 a)) lies below m pi / a, which matters most for the modes near cutoff; n_eff_TE10_discrete uses that discrete wavenumber and agrees to ~1e-6 (eigen-solve and round-off only); te_fraction 0 for TE10 (E_y only) and 1 for TE01 (E_x only).
Curves & tables / Field tab: the last wavelength (3.9 um: TE10 close to its cutoff, the others evanescent); switch the study to Mode analysis for all five modes at the wavelength setting (1.55 um).

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: wavelength of the derived values (one of the study wavelengths)

parameters.name: n_te10

parameters.name: n_te01
